comment: jco is a dev-only tool: scripts/build-phase2-language-variant-fixtures.sh uses it to componentize the TypeScript language-variant fixtures. Nothing shipped imports it.
overridesComment: weval 0.4.1 pulls npm decompress 4.2.1, which carries GHSA-mp2f-45pm-3cg9 (critical), GHSA-h39j-r5qq-r9mm and GHSA-jwp9-9v96-94mx -- all three are archive-extraction escapes (zip slip, arbitrary hardlink, write outside target). decompress is unmaintained and has no patched release, so the fix is to stop depending on it: weval 0.5.0 replaced decompress with tar + fflate + @napi-rs/lzma. componentize-js still pins weval ^0.4.1 upstream, so semver alone cannot reach 0.5.0 and this override is what does it. Drop the override once componentize-js widens that range.
